Proven ability to build conference agendas and session narratives, and to identify, secure and manage senior speakers, including C-suite executives, policymakers and regulators. Excellent writing and communication skills, able to simplify complex financial, regulatory and technological topics without losing accuracy. Confident with senior stakeholders, organised across multiple agendas, speakers and timelines, and comfortable in a fast-paced international environment with travel to GFTN’s forums. Preferred Candidate Background We particularly welcome applications from candidates with experience as a Conference Producer, Agenda Producer, Content Producer, Conference Programme Manager or Editorial/Research Lead in financial services, FinTech, technology, policy or B2B events.
